exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Verb-te iku".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! 動詞ていく matches "Verb-te iku".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is 動詞ていく.
exercises.explanation: Expresses an action continuing or progressing from now into the future.
